note: Corrects batch-009's annotation on the two ownership-parent IČOs that resolve in neither ARES endpoint. Batch 009 recorded them as 'likely historical entity' — directionally right but vague, and it flagged them as a data-integrity concern. The Opus verification pass established the precise, sourced reason: BOTH merged into AGROFERT, a.s. (IČO 26185610), whose `ostatniSkutecnosti` records the mergers. They are therefore NOT anomalous and not a defect in the dataor slice — the ids are simply extinct. Props-merge only; touches no edge and no review_state.
